import math

# January 31, 1970 - Regular weekly and annual maturing bills
# All regular bills maturing in 1970 are outstanding at Jan 31, 1970

print(f'Tax anticipation 1970: {tax_1970}')
print(f'Total 1970: {regular_1970 + tax_1970}')

print()

# January 31, 1975 - Regular weekly and annual maturing bills

tax_1975 = 2251 + 1256
print(f'Tax anticipation 1975: {tax_1975}')

print()

# Absolute changes
change_regular = abs(regular_1975 - regular_1970)
change_tax = abs(tax_1975 - tax_1970)

print(f'Absolute change (regular): {change_regular}')
print(f'Absolute change (tax): {change_tax}')

# Euclidean norm
euclidean_norm = math.sqrt(change_regular**2 + change_tax**2)

print(f'Rounded to nearest hundredths: {round(euclidean_norm, 2)}')
